# Commands Build/Run checkout, cache provenance, and freshness status

Cache snapshot provenance schema 3 stores `source.json` and required installed outputs. `artifact-source.py` resolves exact Taskcluster Gecko/comm revisions through Mach `_make_artifacts()` interception; missing/mismatched provenance falls back to native build. Old downloaded snapshots without source metadata are donors at most, never trusted runnable artifacts. [Task 1]
